posts.name: Outcome

posts.description: Outcome helps creators turn their content and expertise into personalized funnels that listen, understand, and deliver a useful outcome to every lead. Instead of sending everyone the same lead magnet or placing them into a predefined quiz result bucket, an Outcome Funnel uses each person’s answers together with the creator’s content, knowledge, and process to generate something made for them - an action plan, audit, score, roadmap, recommendation, and more.

posts.name: BrowserAct Cloud

Structured data lands in your CSV, JSON, API, or tools like Make, n8n, and Zapier.Build once. Run reliably. Improve continuously.

posts.name: Freebuff

posts.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash

Run multiple agents in parallel without laptop crashes, git worktree wrangling, or port juggling. Instant previews of everything your agents build. Prompt from anywhere with iMessage.

posts.name: NS1

In 5 minutes you'll receive: - Your regulation score: a realistic baseline of how well your system settles after stress - A five-skill scorecard: your strengths and growth edges across the core skills - A personalized path: a structured learning journey to increase your capacity and reclaim agency

posts.name: isolate.video

Describe a scene in plain English, attach product screenshots or a brand kit, and its AI agent builds editable motion, product launch and SaaS explainer videos. Refine layers, timing, easing, colors, camera, and sound on a real canvas and timeline, then export MP4. It works with Codex and Claude Code, with no separate API keys.

posts.name: min.

What customers asked for, why decisions were made, and what matters. min. turns every meeting and email into a your unfair advantage. Free to use. 2-minute setup.

posts.tagline: Al Visual Bookmark Manager for Mac

It gathers everything you save - images, screenshots, links, video and notes - from any app or browser tab, and brings any of it back the instant you look for it. Everything is tagged and organised automatically by on-device AI, and stored entirely on your Mac. $29 once, no subscription. Free for 30 days, no card required.

posts.name: Suno Studio 2.0
posts.tagline: Browser-based generative DAW
posts.description: Suno Studio 2.0 brings MIDI, audio effects, chat, automation and more — you can even design your own plugins and synths.

posts.name: Occasio®
posts.tagline: Pinboard meets citation manager for shared insights.
posts.description: Occasio is your collaborative library of trusted, timeless insights. Distill complex knowledge onto bite-sized index cards and link sources with academic-grade citation rigour. As your library grows, analyse trends and curate endless combinations with zero duplication. Built for research teams and thought leaders who stand for original thinking and have zero tolerance for AI fluff or hallucinated sources.

posts.name: Basedash Tasks
posts.tagline: Run your business on autopilot
posts.description: Tasks is an AI operator for your business. It reads your real data — revenue, churn, activation, pipeline — and turns it into a prioritized backlog of specific, actionable tasks: why now, the expected outcome, and step-by-step instructions. Copy a task into Linear or your agent, or kick it off with the Basedash agent. When it ships, Basedash tracks how your metrics move and learns what actually works. Now in research preview. Your data knows what to do next — Tasks writes it down.

posts.name: Port22
posts.tagline: Claude Code, Codex & more on your phone
posts.description: I'd start a long agent run, walk away, and come back to find it had spent 20 minutes waiting on me to approve one file edit. Port22 puts every coding agent running on your Mac onto your phone. See which are working and which are stuck. When one needs permission your phone buzzes and you tap the actual option it offered, not a guessed keystroke. It attaches to what you already run. No wrapper, no config, no new terminal. Free for one Mac and two sessions, every feature on.

posts.name: Compass Calendar
posts.tagline: The keyboard-first calendar to get organized quickly
posts.description: Compass is a simple, keyboard-first calendar that helps you manage your time. It's built around vim-style shortcuts that make scheduling feel like a fun game of Tetris. If you live at the keyboard and in your calendar, Compass will make your life easier. Although Compass is built around speed, sometimes the most productive thing to do is nothing. That's why we also have a "life" view, which shows your life as a grid of dots. This visual will help you filter out non-essentials.

posts.name: ChordViz
posts.tagline: Build your own music visualizer for MIDI & audio
posts.description: The visual workspace for music teachers and creators. Turn live MIDI and audio into chord, notation and audio-reactive visuals then record video, audio or MIDI natively. Stream to OBS, TouchDesigner and Resolume for live performance.

posts.name: oxpecker
posts.tagline: know which of your lines a vendor just broke
posts.description: Six products will tell you Stripe changed. oxpecker tells you which of your lines it broke — on the pull request, before the sunset date. 26 vendors watched; your source never leaves your CI.

posts.name: Theos[RFM]
posts.tagline: Manage facilities in 3D, in the real world, in real time
posts.description: Our facility management portal provides an immersive and collaborative 3D experience for property owners, facility managers and their workers. We intend to revolutionize the way people manage their Facilities.

posts.name: Unicool
posts.tagline: Spot your child's meltdowns 24 hours ahead
posts.description: Unicool helps families with ADHD and autism spot patterns before a meltdown hits. It learns each child’s signals like sleep or sensory load and suggests expert-backed next steps and practical support. Developed with a child clinical psychologist.

posts.name: Buply
posts.tagline: Reunite lost pets using noseprints
posts.description: Buply is pet safety app that creates a virtual ID for your pet by scanning its unique noseprint (like a fingerprint). Owners can build a detailed profile (breed, color, traits, medical history), and the community can help reunite lost pets by scanning and contacting the owner. We’re starting with dogs (live) and cats (upcoming), and we’re building toward a complete pet platform: safety, health info, adoption, and nearby services — all in one place.

posts.name: Free Video Compressor - By VdoCipher
posts.tagline: Compress up to 10GB videos. No upload needed.

Hardware-accelerated, works offline, and your video never leaves your device. High, Medium, Low compression options.

posts.name: Jspreadsheet

posts.tagline: Nail your next interview

Minutes after you hang up: a score out of 10, feedback on every answer, a stronger rewrite of your weakest ones, and the 3 things to fix before the real one. First interview free — no account, no card. One-time packs after that, no subscription. Audio is never stored, only the transcript.

posts.name: HAR HQ
posts.tagline: Build, scale and govern your AI software factory
posts.description: HAR HQ: the way to implement, extend and govern your AI software factory at scale. Whether you're a high-agency startup or a 5,000-engineer enterprise, HAR HQ unlocks velocity without trading away security, policy or quality.

The easiest way to take screenshots that include the website address. Perfect for bug reports, documentation, tutorials, and sharing web content with context.

posts.name: Kortyx
posts.tagline: Finds tasks to automate and connects every tool to do them
posts.description: Kortyx learns how you work from your desktop activity. It spots repeated tasks, asks if you want help, then figures out how to complete them. It connects to the tools each workflow needs through APIs or a browser, with your approval. Runs on macOS and Windows. Treats blank sheet problem and wont make you spent a weekend wiring connections as you did for OpenClaw.

posts.name: Findabl
posts.tagline: Know when AI recommends your brand, using real citation data
posts.description: Findabl sends real prompts to ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude, then captures the responses, brand mentions, competitor citations, and publisher domains behind each recommendation. See whether AI cites your brand, who it cites instead, and how citation frequency changes over time. No modeled scores. Direct, auditable measurement. Launch code PRODUCTHUNT gets one free full scan at findabl.app/producthunt.

posts.name: FreeTokens by Lovie

posts.description: FreeTokens is a free, open-source desktop agent that helps you access legitimate free tiers from 24 AI providers and use 300+ models through one OpenAI-compatible local API. posts.name: The Long Swell
posts.tagline: Where the climate is abnormal this week, and how bad
posts.description: Every week we measure where the climate is behaving abnormally: heat, fires, crops and El Niño. Each place is compared against its own historical record, not a global average, so the number means something local. Sources named and dated on every figure.

posts.name: Famori
posts.tagline: The AI companion that remembers everything for your family
posts.description: Famori is the AI companion that helps parents manage the invisible mental load of running a family. Keep calendars, reminders, meals, wellness, and family information in one place, then simply ask Famori instead of trying to remember everything yourself.

posts.name: Superrr
posts.tagline: Superrr is an MCP server that gives taste to your agents
posts.description: Connect Superrr to your agent, your landing page will be different than any results you could have.

posts.name: Lynkbio your bio, unlocked
posts.tagline: Your digital identity, all in one place
posts.description: LynkBio is a modern platform that helps you create a personalized page to showcase everything you do online. Share your social profiles, projects, communities, and important links in one place with a fully customizable design. Built with creators, developers, and communities in mind, LynkBio offers a cleaner, faster, and more flexible alternative to traditional “link in bio” tools. Our goal is to make sharing your digital identity simple, beautiful, and unique.

posts.name: Pocket Botanist: Plant ID and Care
posts.tagline: Identify plants, diagnose diseases, daily plant care, & more
posts.description: Most plant apps do one thing. Pocket Botanist brings it all together. Snap a photo for a plant ID, then move straight into diagnosing problems, setting care reminders, and checking if a plant is toxic to pets or family. Watering tips are weather-aware, your hardiness zone is detected automatically, and a journal tracks every plant over time. It closes the loop, so identifying a plant leads naturally into caring for it. Clearer answers and calmer plant care, all in one place.

posts.name: Tanchy
posts.tagline: Your AI Tutor for Investing
posts.description: Ever felt confused by books and articles about the stock market? You finish reading only to end up with more questions than answers? This is what Tanchy solves. Tanchy is your personal stock market tutor, interviews you of your goals, experience, interests and creates a personalized course for you. In the course you can create subthreads if something is not clear, and at the end of a chapter you are quizzed. Tanchy always remembers your questions, quiz answers and puts focus on your weak points.

posts.name: AI Pulse
posts.tagline: Ambient macOS light strip for AI coding agents
posts.description: Ambient macOS light strip for AI coding agents — a Dock-adjacent pill of eight LEDs showing whether anything is working, waiting, finished, or broken

posts.name: Preplyx
posts.tagline: Ace all your exams in one sitting.
posts.description: Ace your WAEC, NECO and JAMB exams with Preplyx—realistic mock CBT tests, lessons, and performance tracking to help you prepare smarter.

posts.tagline: Wake up to what matters.
posts.description: Life_ reads your Gmail and Google Calendar overnight and delivers one calm morning brief by email worldwide, with optional US text delivery. Free limited beta. It's different because it doesn't require the user to know about the underlying technology, and it also meets the user with an empowering aesthetic to start each day.

posts.name: Vylor AI
posts.tagline: AI engineering where you're the driver
posts.description: Vylor is a cloud-based AI engineering workspace for your entire multi-repo architecture. Work through engineering problems with AI like another engineer who already understands your codebase. Vylor connects the relevant parts of your system so you can explore solutions, make technical decisions, and iterate in real time. Move from idea to implementation across APIs, frontends, and infrastructure, with up to 8× lower model costs.

posts.name: inkScript
posts.tagline: Your e-reader into a typewriter
posts.description: inkScript uses your e-reader’s browser to give you an eInk distraction-free writing environment. Touch the screen to move your cursor, select a portion of your text to copy it, move it or apply styling. Organize your texts into folders, search through them, pin them for quick access, etc. The actual text is stored in iCloud, the app runs on iOS and macOS — just use whatever device you prefer at the moment.

posts.name: Breakdown
posts.tagline: See what’s breaking your connection
posts.description: When calls or cloud apps stall, Breakdown shows whether the problem starts with Wi-Fi, your ISP, or the app. It's a lightweight Mac utility right in your menu-bar.

posts.name: AplyGED
posts.tagline: A voice tutor that teaches the next step
posts.description: AplyGED is a voice-first tutor for adult GED learners. Instead of simply giving answers, it uses hints, guided questions, and step-by-step support across Math, Science, Social Studies, and RLA. Learners can practice, reflect on mistakes, and build confidence while preparing for the GED.

posts.name: AI Transitions
posts.tagline: Turn two images into a smooth AI transition video
posts.description: Upload a first frame and a last frame. AI generates a continuous motion video between them — not a fade preset. Free credits after signup, no watermark, MP4 in seconds. Works in the browser.

posts.name: LaunchSafely.ai
posts.tagline: The safe way to launch the app you vibe coded
posts.description: You built an app with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit, or Claude Code. Is it safe to put in front of real customers? Launch Safely is a Mac app that checks your project the way a CTO would: 19 checks for exposed customer data, leaked keys, surprise bills, and things that break with real users. Click "Fix it for me" and agents repair everything, re-run all 19 checks to prove it, then deploy your app to a live URL with your own domain. Built for founders who vibe code.

posts.name: FollowStack
posts.tagline: See who unfollowed you on Instagram — without a password
posts.description: Every "who unfollowed me" tool wants your Instagram password. FollowStack never asks for one — it is a Chrome extension, so it uses the session you are already logged into and analyses everything locally. See who unfollowed you since your last check, who does not follow back, and which followers are bots or ghosts, scored on profile photo, follower ratio, post count and username. Export to CSV, Excel or JSON, schedule stories from desktop, download media. Free tier. 51 languages.

posts.name: Professional Invoices in Under 60 Sec
posts.tagline: Create beautiful professional invoices in under 60 seconds
posts.description: InvoiceSpark helps freelancers, entrepreneurs, and small businesses create professional invoices in seconds. Generate polished PDFs, manage clients, track payments, and organize your billing—all from your phone. Designed to save time so you can focus on growing your business.

posts.name: HagePasha
posts.tagline: Consistent photos of your hairline and crown
posts.description: Take consistently framed photos of your hairline and crown, then compare your own record over time. No account needed. Photos stay in the app's private area on your device.

posts.name: Nativia
posts.tagline: Learn a language by living a life you can change.
posts.description: Nativia turns language learning into an interactive life abroad. Move to a new city, meet characters, hear natural conversations and reply freely with your voice. What you say and decide changes how the story unfolds. After every response, get instant grammar, pronunciation and naturalness feedback. Built for learners who know the basics but want to actually understand locals and speak on their own.

posts.name: CameraFort
posts.tagline: Photo gear management tool
posts.description: Born in a Guns N' Roses concert line in Amsterdam, CameraFort is the ultimate vault for pro gear management. 🎸📸 ✅ AI Invoice Scanning: Auto-extract specs from receipts. ✅ Web Dashboard: Bulk import gear via desktop. ✅ Smart Kits: Organize setups & export pro PDF reports. ✅ Pro Reminders: Auto-alerts for charging, cleaning & warranties. ✅ Full Sync: Real-time data between iOS, Android & Web. Secure your photography arsenal across all devices today. 🏰✨

posts.name: Fitly AI
posts.tagline: One AI agent instead of five fitness apps
posts.description: Fitly AI is an AI agent that runs your whole fitness life through one conversation. Type, talk, or send a photo and it logs meals, workouts, water, and weight. Name a destination (down 20 by the wedding, a first 10K) and it writes the game plan: your meals, your training, your pace to arrival. When life throws a curveball, the plan bends, not you. It is also an open platform: an MCP server with 50+ tools lets Claude, ChatGPT, or any agent you already use read your progress and log for you.

posts.name: ALEX
posts.tagline: One person. Full agency. Your back office on autopilot.

posts.description: ScreenWith.me automates hiring from application to shortlist. AI screens resumes, runs structured async video interviews, asks smart follow-up questions, scores and summarizes responses, and automatically shortlists top candidates. Add knockout questions, AI-graded assessments, automated candidate emails, and a built-in ATS so your team spends less time screening and more time meeting the right people.

posts.name: AI Bytes
posts.tagline: Daily AI News tailored for your role
posts.description: Hi, I'm Sushmita - a full-time PM, building this on weekends and evenings. AI news is everywhere, but it's buried in the algorithm, same 10 links in every newsletter, telling nobody what to actually do about it. So I built AI Bytes: a 2-min daily AI briefing that's different per role (Dev, PM, Marketer - more soon). Each story comes with "what this means for you" + one action item. 🎯 Different stories per role ⚡ Fully automated 📰 Pulls from 15+ sources daily

posts.name: Claude Code CLI Proxy
posts.tagline: Convert claude desktop as API and save extra API credits.
posts.description: If you’re using Claude Code with a subscription, but also paying separately for LLM API keys to power your agents or applications… you might be paying twice. 👀 I built claude-cli-proxy to turn your locally authenticated Claude Code CLI into a local API server. So your existing agents, SDKs and applications can use Claude through: http://127.0.0.1:7274 No separate API key. No additional per-token API billing. Just use the Claude Code subscription you already have. Try it:npx claude-cli-proxy

posts.description: Professional document templates for small businesses and freelancers. Generate, manage and e-sign documents such as contracts, invoices, proposals, and more in minutes.

posts.name: PulseCheck
posts.tagline: Your visit, decoded. Your recovery, tracked.
posts.description: PulseCheck bridges the gap between complex medical syncs and daily patient compliance. While a user speaks with their physician, Granola extracts the unstructured conversation into precise clinical entities. In real time. The application maps prescriptions onto a chronological timeline with micro-animated check-ins and an absolute "Now" tracker, loops action items into a unified spring-physics progression ring, and translates dense clinical jargon into friendly, reassuring terms with a tap.

posts.name: Weekly Planner
posts.tagline: Plan the week once. Shop for it in one trip.
posts.description: Meal Plan is a free, single-file weekly meal planner that does the annoying part for you: turning a week of meals into a shopping list. Fill in breakfast, lunch, and dinner across a 7-day grid, and every ingredient automatically aggregates into a categorized grocery list — deduplicated, sorted, ready to shop from. No account, no app, no subscription.

From SaaS and AI tools to productivity, design, marketing, finance, and developer tools, Indie Need helps people discover what’s new while giving indie builders a simple way to launch, promote, and grow.

Maybe it's a birthday and you're tired of typing 'happy birthday'. Write it as a letter instead. Customize it, change the font, add a cute icon and send it straight to their inbox.

posts.name: WhisperNote
posts.tagline: Your thoughts disappear. Your peace remains.
posts.description: WhisperNote is a private space to clear your mind. Speak or write your thoughts freely, knowing they are not saved. WhisperNote is designed for moments when you need to release what's on your mind without creating another digital record. With an AI listener, you can have a calm, supportive conversation and feel heard — without judgment. Sometimes thoughts don't need to be stored. They just need to be released.

posts.name: CaloriSnap

posts.name: Daxo OS
posts.tagline: Rust kernel that boots on metal and runs user code in Ring 3

posts.name: CampaignGateway

CampaignGateway is mean for all campaigns but targets smaller campaigns that lack the funds to support larger CRM products. All CampaignGateway modules interlink which makes it more seamless and organized than many alternatives.

posts.name: Codnity CRM
posts.tagline: A clean, modern CRM for teams tired of HubSpot bloat
posts.description: A clean, fast CRM for teams who don't want to manage a HubSpot subscription just to manage a pipeline. Deals live on a live kanban board with custom stages and probabilities. Dashboards are build-your-own and shareable per role. Field reports and quotes/invoicing are built in, not bolted on with Zapier. Your logo and accent color carry through the whole app it looks like your company, not a template.

posts.name: Ringloom
posts.tagline: AI voice operations for every business call
posts.description: Ringloom is an AI voice operations platform for inbound reception and outbound outreach. It answers business calls, handles FAQs from a company’s own knowledge base, captures booking requests, transfers callers, and runs lead campaigns with transcripts, outcomes, DNC controls, and a live dashboard. We’re launching an early-access version for teams that want to test one voice platform for calls coming in and opportunities going out.

posts.name: FreeSignature
posts.tagline: Create a professional email signature in 30 seconds
posts.description: FreeSignature is a free, no-sign-up email signature generator. Pick a template, enter your name, role, and contact details, customize the accent color, and copy a ready-to-use HTML signature for Gmail, Outlook, or Apple Mail — all in your browser, no account needed.

posts.name: Take a Seat
posts.tagline: Wedding& Party Seating Charts
posts.description: Pick a floor plan, paste your guest list, and drag people onto seats. Auto-seat everyone in one click, tag guests by group, then print a seating poster, place cards, and table tents. No account, nothing ever leaves your device.

posts.name: The World at Play
posts.tagline: Play the world’s strategy games against browser-local AI
posts.description: Play 53 classic and modern strategy games from around the world against adjustable AI that runs entirely in your browser. Every game includes complete rules, beginner guidance, and on-demand Master Hints; six also include daily puzzles and progressive journeys. Free, no ads, no account required—and your gameplay stays on your device.

posts.name: VinAudit Data
posts.tagline: One API for vehicle data, history, market value, images
posts.description: VinAudit Data is a unified automotive data platform for developers, startups, dealers, marketplaces, lenders and insurers. Access VIN decoding, specs, market listings, valuations, NMVTIS-backed vehicle history, images and monitoring through one API. Cover the U.S. and Canada without stitching together multiple data providers. Start a free trial!

posts.name: WalletRoam
posts.tagline: Global eSIM with No Expiry Travel Data
posts.description: WalletRoam is a global pay-as-you-go travel eSIM that lets travellers top up a prepaid wallet instead of buying fixed-duration data plans. Your unused balance never expires.

posts.name: QRcritter
posts.tagline: Free QR code generator with logo & color customization
posts.description: QRcritter is a completely free QR code generator — no signup, no watermark, no expiry. Make codes for links, WiFi, contact cards, email, and phone, then brand them with your own logo, colors, and dot styles. Download high-res PNG or vector SVG that scales perfectly for print. Every code is static, so it works forever, and everything is generated right in your browser — nothing you type is uploaded or stored. Free QR codes, with a friendly little critter inside.

posts.name: Ulegal AI
posts.tagline: Smart Legal Chatbot
posts.description: Our AI legal assistant reimagines document review with multi-agent reasoning. Instantly review contracts, identify risks, and ensure regulatory compliance.

posts.name: OpenInfer Cloud
posts.tagline: Run open AI models through one inference API
posts.description: Hi Product Hunt, I’m Claire from OpenInfer. We built OpenInfer Cloud to make our inference platform directly accessible to developers, not just infrastructure partners and enterprise POCs. We’re opening it to early users building agents, AI applications, creative workflows, and other production use cases. We’d particularly value feedback on the onboarding experience, model selection, documentation, and what developers need before moving a real workload.

posts.name: Bull vs Bear
posts.tagline: Build your trading instincts, one chart at a time
posts.description: Bull vs Bear turns learning price action into an interactive game. Players face real market scenarios and choose Bull, Bear or No Trade, commit to their decision, then reveal what happened next. The goal is to build pattern recognition, decision-making and trading instincts through repetition—without risking real money. This launch includes Quick Play, Daily Challenge, progressive difficulty and session reviews.

posts.name: WhisperNote
posts.tagline: Your thoughts disappear. Your peace remains.
posts.description: WhisperNote is a private space to clear your mind. Speak or write your thoughts freely, knowing they are not saved. WhisperNote is designed for moments when you need to release what's on your mind without creating another digital record. With an AI listener, you can have a calm, supportive conversation and feel heard — without judgment. Sometimes thoughts don't need to be stored. They just need to be released.

posts.name: CaloriSnap
posts.tagline: Free AI calorie tracker — snap, type or speak your meal
posts.description: Track calories by photo with CaloriSnap. AI-powered nutrition analysis, barcode scanner, an AI coach and insights – completely free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Codnity CRM
posts.tagline: A clean, modern CRM for teams tired of HubSpot bloat
posts.description: A clean, fast CRM for teams who don't want to manage a HubSpot subscription just to manage a pipeline. Deals live on a live kanban board with custom stages and probabilities. Dashboards are build-your-own and shareable per role. Field reports and quotes/invoicing are built in, not bolted on with Zapier. Your logo and accent color carry through the whole app it looks like your company, not a template.

posts.name: Matcha Filter Remover
posts.tagline: Turn matcha-filtered images into natural AI reconstructions
posts.description: Remove heavy olive-green, posterized matcha effects with structure-preserving AI reconstruction. One free try, no subscription.

posts.name: SensoryFlow
posts.tagline: Predict sensory meltdowns & simplify IEP advocacy with AI
posts.description: SensoryFlow is a comprehensive web platform bridging families, clinicians, and special educators. Features AI room photo audits, predictive sensory overload telemetry with wearable bio-feedback, IEP/504 legal advocacy demand letter generation, and AAC speech communication tools.

posts.name: Backchannel
posts.tagline: The internet's commentary track.
posts.description: Backchannel brings the internet's conversations into whatever you're reading. It blends Hacker News, Bluesky, Reddit, and more into a single discussion thread beside any page, then brings those sources together into a blended front page when you're ready to find something new.

posts.name: Chenox
posts.tagline: Notes, AI chat, music, widgets. All in one productivityhub
posts.description: An all-in-one productivity command center featuring an AI assistant, smart calendar, and social media content engine to keep your plans and ideas perfectly aligned.

posts.name: Daxo OS
posts.tagline: Rust kernel that boots on metal and runs user code in Ring 3
posts.description: An experimental x86_64 kernel built completely from scratch in Rust. Designed as a clean, mostly-safe systems programming playground, it boots natively via UEFI, sets up 4-level paging, runs user-space applications in Ring 3 via GDT/TSS switching, manages a cooperative async task executor, and includes a custom fixed-size heap allocator alongside an ATA PIO driver.

posts.name: TokenUse
posts.tagline: AI Token and cost observability for developers
posts.description: Track, analyze, and optimize LLM token usage from AI coding agents with a real-time dashboard, per-model and per-project visibility, alerts, and budget controls.

posts.name: MyRentLog
posts.tagline: Simple property management app for tenants
posts.description: MyRentLog helps tenants track rent payments, manage rental agreements, and keep all property communication in one clear place. No complicated spreadsheets—just a simple app to stay in control of your tenancy.

posts.name: NexoreUI
posts.tagline: Premium animated React UI components for modern web apps
posts.description: NexoreUI is a React UI library for premium, animated components built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. It includes Nexore Make, a visual builder for customizing components and exporting JSX/HTML/Vue code. The project is live, in v0.1.2, indexed by Google Search Console, and actively evolving. It is designed for developers who want production-ready UI without spending hours building animations from scratch. NexoreUI is focused on speed and creating polished interfaces that stand out

posts.name: bePublish
posts.tagline: Content engine for solo brands that sell
posts.description: Build your own platform, escape social media algorithms, and sell your digital products globally with the TanaFlows Ghost theme.
